verdict.rationale: Gusto now offers business banking and a Money Dashboard that shows money coming in and going out, so AI-assisted bill capture is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows AI reading incoming bills or auto-populating payment details for review. The MCP server, CLI and webhooks are developer building blocks for payroll and do not provide this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI read incoming bills and auto-populate payment details for my review
